paite: Huan David in Israel heutu tengteng nam makaipente, kumpipa nasem a kikheng zelzel pawl heutute, sepaih sangkhat heutute, zakhat heutute, kumpipa leh atapate sum leh thil neih tengteng tung a heutute, milian mihat, mihat hangsan tengtengte toh Jerusalem ah asamkhawm hi.
heading: Tempul A Dia David Thilgelte
english: David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, the captains of the companies who served the king by division, the captains of thousands, the captains of hundreds, and the rulers over all the substance and possessions of the king and of his sons, with the officers and the mighty men, even all the mighty men of valor, to Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa David adingh a, "Ka unaute leh ka mite aw, ka thu na ngaikhia dih ua, ke'n TOUPA thukhun bawm koihna leh i Pathian khe ngakna ding inn lam lungsim in ka nei gige a; alamna ding leng ka ngah khin sipsip hi.
english: Then David the king stood up on his feet and said, “Hear me, my brothers and my people! As for me, it was in my heart to build a house of rest for the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, and for the footstool of our God; and I had prepared for the building.

paite: Himahleh, Pathian in ka kiang ah, 'Nang zaw kidoumi sisan suahmi na hih ziak in ka min a ding in inn na lam kei ding,' achi hi.
english: But God said to me, ‘You shall not build a house for my name, because you are a man of war and have shed blood.’

paite: Himahleh TOUPA Israel' Pathian in, ka pa inkote tengteng lak a kipan Israelte kumpipa dia tangtawn a om ding in ahon na telta a; Judah makai pipen ding in ana telta a; Judah namte lak ah ka pa inkote; ka pa tapate lak a kipan Israel tengteng kumpipa ding in ahon na telkhe tuamta hi.
english: However Yahweh, the God of Israel, chose me out of all the house of my father to be king over Israel forever. For he has chosen Judah to be prince; and in the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he took pleasure in me to make me king over all Israel.

paite: TOUPA'N tapa tampi ahon pia a, ka tapa tengteng lak ah, Israelte kumpipa ding in TOUPA gam laltutphah a tu ding in ka tapa Solomon ana telta hi.
english: Of all my sons (for Yahweh has given me many sons), he has chosen Solomon my son to sit on the throne of Yahweh’s kingdom over Israel.

paite: "Huchi in ka kiang ah, 'Na tapa Solomon in ka inn leh ka intualte adingsak ding; ka tapa ding in ka telta a, huchi in apa ka hi ding.
english: He said to me, ‘Solomon, your son, shall build my house and my courts; for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.

paite: Ka thupiakte leh ka vaihawmte apom gigeleh tua na hih gige bang un agam tangtawn a ding in ka kipsak ding hi.'
english: I will establish his kingdom forever if he continues to do my commandments and my ordinances, as it is today.’

paite: Huchi in TOUPA mipi, Israelte tengteng mitmuh in leh i Pathian zak in TOUPA na Pathian uh thupiak tengteng pom ding leh limsak ding in ka hon hanthawn ahi; huchi in hiai gam hoih mahmah na luah ding ua, na nung uah na suante uh tangtawn a ding in na luahtou sawnsak zel ding uhi.
english: Now therefore, in the sight of all Israel, Yahweh’s assembly, and in the audience of our God, observe and seek out all the commandments of Yahweh your God, that you may possess this good land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children after you forever.

paite: "Huan nang, ka tapa Solomon, na pa Pathian thei inla, lungtang hoih bukim leh lungsim kilawptak in anasep sem in; TOUPA'N lah lungtang a-en sek a, lungsim a lunggel tengteng athei vek hi; amah na zonleh na mu ding a, na lehngatsanleh bel tangtawn in ahon khahkhe ding hi.
english: You, Solomon my son, know the God of your father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind; for Yahweh searches all hearts, and understands all the imaginations of the thoughts. If you seek him, he will be found by you; but if you forsake him, he will cast you off forever.

paite: Pilvang in; mun siangthou a dia inn lam ding in TOUPA'N nang ahon septa; hattak in om inla, pang in," achi hi.
english: Take heed now, for Yahweh has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary. Be strong, and do it.”

paite: Huchi in David in atapa Solomon kiang ah atempul intual, asum koihkhawmna, adantan tungnung, asung dantan, azahngaihna tutphah,
english: Then David gave to Solomon his son the plans for the porch of the temple, for its houses, for its treasuries, for its upper rooms, for its inner rooms, for the place of the mercy seat;

paite: Alungsim a alunggel bang tengteng, TOUPA' inn um sung intual, akim dantan tengteng, Pathian in asum koihkhawmna inn, thil tan koihkhawmna inn lamdan ding guhgel apia hi.
english: and the plans of all that he had by the Spirit, for the courts of Yahweh’s house, for all the surrounding rooms, for the treasuries of God’s house, and for the treasuries of the dedicated things;

paite: Siampute leh Levite apawlpawl a a-omna ding uh lim, TOUPA' inn a nasepna lam ding tengteng lim, TOUPA' inn a nasepna ding tui-um belsuan tengteng lim leng.
english: also for the divisions of the priests and the Levites, for all the work of the service of Yahweh’s house, and for all the vessels of service in Yahweh’s house—

paite: Nasepna lam a dia tui-um belsuan chi chih, dangka-eng tui-um belsuan ding, dangka-eng zat zel zah ding,
english: of gold by weight for the gold for all vessels of every kind of service, for all the vessels of silver by weight, for all vessels of every kind of service;

paite: Dangka-eng khawnvak koihna leh akhawnvak ding dangka-eng zat zel zah ding, khawnvak koihna leh akhawnvak tui ding a zat zel zah ding, khawnvak koihna a mun kiphamoh chiat bang zel a dangkasik khawnvak koihna ding a dia zat zel zah ding toh;
english: by weight also for the lamp stands of gold, and for its lamps, of gold, by weight for every lamp stand and for its lamps; and for the lamp stands of silver, by weight for every lamp stand and for its lamps, according to the use of every lamp stand;

paite: tanghou at koihna ding dangka-eng dohkan leh dangkasik dohkan bawlna ding a, dangka-eng zat zah ding leh dangkasik zat zel zah ding atehna in apia hi.
english: and the gold by weight for the tables of show bread, for every table; and silver for the tables of silver;

paite: Maiphiatna kuang, noute toh; dangka-eng belhbu ding, belhbu khat zel a dia zat zel zah ding.
english: and the forks, the basins, and the cups, of pure gold; and for the golden bowls by weight for every bowl; and for the silver bowls by weight for every bowl;

paite: Cherubte akha uh zak a; TOUPA thukhun bawm tuam tuanna lim bang bawlna ding dangka-engte toh.
english: and for the altar of incense, refined gold by weight; and gold for the plans for the chariot, and the cherubim that spread out and cover the ark of Yahweh’s covenant.

paite: David in, "Hiaite tengteng TOUPA'N amah mah khut a hon gelh, hiai a lim tengteng hon theisak hi in ka thei," achi hi.
english: “All this”, David said, “I have been made to understand in writing from Yahweh’s hand, even all the works of this pattern.”

paite: Huchi in David in atapa Solomon kiang ah, "Hattak leh hangsantak in om inla, pang in; lau ke'nla, lunglel sam ke'n; TOUPA Pathian, ka Pathian na kiang ah a-om hi; TOUPA' inn lam nasep tengteng zoh ahih vek mateng hon paisan in, ahon limsak lou kei ding hi.
english: David said to Solomon his son, “Be strong and courageous, and do it. Don’t be afraid, nor be dismayed, for Yahweh God, even my God, is with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you, until all the work for the service of Yahweh’s house is finished.

paite: Huan ngai dih, Pathian in na chih teng semmi pawl siampute leh Levite a-om ua, bang nna peuh a, bang lam peuh a nasep siam, hattak chiat a nang hon panpih ding na kiang ah a-om zel ding uhi; heutute leh mipi teng in leng na thupiak peuhmah azui ding uhi," achi hi.
english: Behold, there are the divisions of the priests and the Levites for all the service of God’s house. Every willing man who has skill for any kind of service shall be with you in all kinds of work. Also the captains and all the people will be entirely at your command.”
